claims.text: Machine-learning-accelerated TOR-TILD can improve determination of the solid-to-fluid transition temperature relative to existing experimental and computational baselines.
Machine-learning-accelerated TOR-TILD can improve determination of fusion enthalpy relative to existing experimental and computational baselines.
Machine-learning-accelerated TOR-TILD can improve determination of fusion entropy relative to existing experimental and computational baselines.
Machine-learning-accelerated TOR-TILD can improve determination of the volume change at the transition relative to existing experimental and computational baselines.
Machine-learning-accelerated TOR-TILD can improve determination of dense-fluid heat capacity relative to existing experimental and computational baselines.
The proposed machine-learning-accelerated TOR-TILD approach retains ab initio-level accuracy.
The proposed approach represents all thermodynamic effects relevant to the transition.
Representing all relevant thermodynamic effects leads to improved determination of the listed transition and dense-fluid properties.
The proposed approach is applicable to high-entropy materials in high-temperature states.
The proposed approach is intended to operate across relevant compositions and temperatures.
There is insufficient data for systematic screening of high-entropy materials.
Direct evidence for machine-learning-accelerated TOR-TILD in high-entropy materials is lacking.
